entities.summary: Arnold Thackray is an emeritus professor at the University of Pennsylvania. He has held academic positions at institutions, including a visiting fellowship at All Souls College, Oxford, and a fellowship at Churchill College, Cambridge. He has also taught at the London School of Economics, Harvard University, the Institute for Advanced Study, the Center for Advanced Study in the Behavioral Sciences at Stanford, and the Hebrew University of Jerusalem.
